note: docs/253 §7-§8: DanceFloor follower route "Collection was modified" stress hunt on pair dancediag1108 (Rodney 2026-11-08: one job, no off arms; the RouteAsync-off, GC-off and CasTrim arms are dropped). Correctness only (run with --no-smoke), no timing. One load on Baseline-BP: release ini with our mods on, dancefloorlistdiag on (counters 892-897; a diagnostic, no guard), the repro dance-together-floor on up to 4 Bridgeport lots with a dance floor at once (Waylon's Haunt first; each with its own pool of 6 NPCs): phase A one pair 6 cycles, phase B 6 rotating pairs, phase C the 3 pairs of every floor dancing at once for 3 min, repeated until the window ends. Stop rule: BREAKS = the early gate stops the job at the first THROW or MISMATCH (row FAIL by design: that is the finding); CLEARS = 30 min with 0 throws and 0 mismatches.

jobs.note: BREAKS or CLEARS (~32 min). Release ini as is, dancefloorlistdiag on through the repro (phases A, B, then C repeated) on 4 floors at once. Cap 30 min: phases A+B take ~16 min (a cycle waits ~70 s for the slowest of 4 floors) = 48 single-pair floor routes (12 cycles x 4 floors, every second cycle with a forced collection), then phase C runs ~14 min with 6 NPCs dancing as 3 pairs on each of 4 floors = ~56 floor-minutes of a 6-NPC crowd, ~5x hit 1 (5-6 NPCs for ~10 min on one floor), so 0 throws here is clearly more floor use than the case that threw. Per-floor cam seen/far is logged on every cycle line (off-camera floors are evidence, not a problem). BREAKS: the early gate on fixes dancefloordiag_throws + _mismatch stops the job at the next guard poll; read in the job ts3native.log the "dancefloor list: THROW|MISMATCH" line (call #, ver, count, gc a->b, slept ms, async starts, actor/followers), the "dancefloor repro: cycle #n phase P lot L cam seen|far Dm actor X partner Y floor_sims K calls C" line before it (its cycle: the last with C < call #; the lot field of both lines names the floor), and the [CrashForensics] Light lines around it. CLEARS: PASS with dancefloordiag_throws = 0 and _mismatch = 0, calls >= 20; the script error report lists any "Collection was modified" in the game log (REPORT, never FAIL).
